verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਰਸ ਲਿਵ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਸਾਧ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਹੈ॥
verses.translit_en: gur sikh sa(n)dh mile dhirasaT dharas liv gurmukh braham giaan saadh liv laiee hai||

en.bdb: When the devoted Guru-conscious person becomes one with the True form of the True Lord, his vision enjoins the holy sight of Guru. He who practices meditation on Lord's name remains attached with the words of wisdom of the True Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸੁਧਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੈ॥
verses.translit_en: gur sikh sa(n)dh mile sabadh surat liv gurmukh braham giaan dhiaan sudh paiee hai||

en.bdb: By the union of True Guru and his disciple (Gursikh) the disciple obeys the command of his Guru very sincerely and faithfully. By meditating on the Lord, he learns to reflect on the True Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸ੍ਵਾਮੀ ਸੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ ਹੁਇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਕਰਨੀ ਕਮਾਈ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: gur sikh sa(n)dh mile savaiaamee sev sevak hui gurmukh nihakaam karanee kamaiee hai ||

en.bdb: Thus union of a disciple with Guru imbibes the trait of service of the Master. He serves all without reward or desire as he has learnt that he is serving Him who resides in all.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਕਰਨੀ ਸੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੇ੍ਰਮ ਨੇਮ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੈ ॥੫੦॥
verses.translit_en: gur sikh sa(n)dh mile karanee su giaan dhiaan gurmukh peram nem sahaj samaiee hai ||50||

en.bdb: Such a person emerges as a person with ideal actions by virtue of the meditation and reflection on Lord. In the process, he attains equipoise and remains engrossed in it. (50)
